items.title: Human-Inspired Memory Architecture for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 智能体的类人记忆架构
items.summary: The architecture combines six cognitive mechanisms - sleep-phase consolidation, interference-based forgetting, engram maturation, reconsolidation upon retrieval, entity knowledge graphs and hybrid multi-cue retrieval - with thresholds calibrated without benchmark exposure. On a 13K-issue VSCode dataset, deduplication-based consolidation reached 97.2% retention precision with 58% store reduction, and on LongMemEval it matched raw retrieval accuracy (70.1% vs. 71.2%) at a 200K-token context budget.

items.title: Injection-Execution Dissociation: A Mechanistic Evaluation of Persistent Memory Attacks and Defenses in Stateful LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 注入-执行分离：有状态 LLM 智能体持久记忆攻击与防御的机制评估
items.summary: The study separates whether a stateful agent stores an injected instruction from whether it later acts on it, evaluating 29 frontier endpoints with a malicious document in the retrieval corpus. Execution was common, and models that never exfiltrated in draft-only runs sometimes did when a follow-up supplied content and asked for a send; only removing the recall tool blocked the attack, and even that was bypassed when models rebuilt the instruction from the corpus.

items.title: CoCoDA: Co-evolving Compositional DAG for Tool-Augmented Agents
items.title_zh: CoCoDA：面向工具增强智能体的协同进化组合 DAG
items.summary: CoCoDA co-evolves a planner and tool library around a compositional code DAG whose nodes store typed signatures, descriptions, pre- and post-conditions and worked examples, with typed retrieval pruning candidates before context materialization. Successful trajectories are folded into validated composite tools, and an 8B student matches or exceeds a 32B teacher on GSM8K and MATH.

items.title: Adaptive Parallel Reasoning: The Next Paradigm in Efficient Inference Scaling
items.title_zh: 自适应并行推理：高效推理扩展的下一个范式
items.summary: A Berkeley AI Research overview surveys adaptive parallel reasoning, in which a reasoning model decides for itself when to decompose independent subtasks, how many concurrent threads to spawn and how to coordinate them. The post combines a landscape survey with the authors' perspective and notes that a co-author helped lead ThreadWeaver, one of the methods discussed.

items.title: Do Agents Need to Plan Step-by-Step? Rethinking Planning Horizon in Data-Centric Tool Calling
items.title_zh: 智能体需要逐步规划吗？重新思考数据中心工具调用中的规划视野
items.summary: A controlled study isolates planning horizon, comparing full-horizon plans with single-step interleaving across knowledge-base QA and multi-hop QA. Full-horizon planning with lazy replanning matches single-step accuracy across depths, breadths and robustness levels while using two to three times fewer tokens.

items.title: Do Benchmarks Underestimate LLM Performance? Evaluating Hallucination Detection With LLM-First Human-Adjudicated Assessment
items.title_zh: 基准是否低估了 LLM 性能？用 LLM 优先、人工裁决的评估检验幻觉检测
items.summary: The study re-adjudicates conflicts between original human annotations and reason- and span-based judgments from Gemini 2.5 Flash and GPT-5 Mini on QAGS-C and SummEval. Triple agreement rose 6.38% and 7.62%, with adjudicators often siding with models when they gave explicit reasoning, and overall human adjudicator agreement ranged from 83% to 87%.

items.title: When Independent Sampling Outperforms Agentic Reasoning
items.title_zh: 当独立采样优于智能体推理
items.summary: Evaluating 216 Codeforces problems across Divisions 1-3, the authors compare agent-based reasoning with repeated independent k-shot sampling under fixed budgets. K-shot consistently gives better accuracy-cost and accuracy-query tradeoffs, even with prompt caching in agent frameworks.

items.title: MiA-Signature: Approximating Global Activation for Long-Context Understanding
items.title_zh: MiA-Signature：为长上下文理解近似全局激活
items.summary: MiA-Signature compresses the global activation pattern a query induces by submodularly selecting high-level concepts, then uses that representation as conditioning for long-context RAG and agentic systems.

items.title: StraTA: Incentivizing Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Strategic Trajectory Abstraction
items.title_zh: StraTA：用策略轨迹抽象激励智能体强化学习
items.summary: StraTA samples an explicit trajectory-level strategy before acting and trains strategy generation jointly with execution through hierarchical GRPO. It reports 93.1% on ALFWorld, 84.2% on WebShop and 63.5% on SciWorld.

items.title: Skill1: Unified Evolution of Skill-Augmented Agents via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Skill1：通过强化学习统一演化技能增强智能体
items.summary: Skill1 trains a single policy to co-evolve skill selection, utilization and distillation from one task-outcome signal, and reports gains over prior skill-based and RL baselines on ALFWorld and WebShop.

items.title: AutoTrustAI/PaperGuru-Benchmark
items.summary: PaperGuru-Benchmark is a trending repository presenting lifecycle-aware memory for long-horizon LLM agents, reporting 66.05% on PaperBench and 94.66% on SurveyBench, with ten peer-reviewed acceptances at FSE, ICML, TOSEM, AEI and ICoGB.

items.title: PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent
items.summary: prime-agent is a trending Rust repository from PrimeIntellect, described as a self-improving RLM agent for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks; it has 22,331 stars and 2,475 forks.

items.title: Running Codex safely at OpenAI
items.title_zh: 在 OpenAI 安全地运行 Codex
items.summary: OpenAI describes how it runs Codex securely using sandboxing, approvals, network policies and agent-native telemetry to support safe and compliant adoption of coding agents.

items.title: Show HN: Git for AI Agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：面向 AI 智能体的 Git
items.summary: The Show HN launch presents re_gent, an open-source version-control tool that records what an AI coding agent did, supports blaming lines back to a prompt and rewinding, and currently works with Claude Code.

items.title: Teaching Claude Why
items.summary: An Anthropic research post describes work on reducing agentic misalignment in Claude, framed as teaching the model why.
